Class AJsonMessage

java.lang.Object
com.owltask.infra.msgs.AJsonMessage
All Implemented Interfaces:
IJsonMessage
Direct Known Subclasses:
JsonDataMsg
public abstract class AJsonMessage extends Object implements IJsonMessage
Abstract implementation of IJsonMessage that implements having a message type.

IMPORTANT WARNING!!
The typescript-generator utility is unable to synchronize specific values between Java and TypeScript, and thus is unable to properly transfer the name of the message type field in JSON messages used on the Java side.

THE NAME OF THE MESSAGE TYPE FIELD BELOW (= value of IApiDefs.MSG_TYPE_KEY) MUST BE MANUALLY SYNCHRONIZED WITH THE VALUE OF THE messagingUtils.MSG_TYPE_KEY CONSTANT VALUE ON THE TypeScript SIDE!
